findings.title: Copy-input join is later than ITR pre-hit and public ITR args lack a full hit transaction
findings.evidence: Both317 actor hits emit pre-hit before CopyHitData/IMPACT_HIT, then pre-health, then ShowOff impact. ITR supplies one product scaling health/limb/fatigue, no projectile/ammo transaction, and bypasses documented producer cases.
findings.consequence: Late joins cannot feed the already-dispatched pre-hit event; proximity pairing or multiplying both streams can misattribute or double-scale future damage.
findings.minimal_fix_or_check: Specify and verify one guarded full-context boundary before relevant application, plus identity/terminal outcome, unsupported and recursion policy. Keep it read-only until established.

findings.title: Brahmin Baron has a separate DamageAV/Kill hit path
findings.evidence: Required deployed NVO records register OnHit for player victim/attacker and separately damage or kill using carried caps.
findings.consequence: A future single damage owner would leave a second health-loss path enabled for this background unless explicitly migrated or excluded.
findings.minimal_fix_or_check: Trace and migrate this rule into the coordinated owner or explicitly exclude its background from the first activation; retire actual registrations when replacing it, preserving unrelated start behavior.

findings.title: RD contains the old noisy bootstrap and old-only JIP check
findings.evidence: RD start-enabled quest01000DBF references script01000DBE with compiledSCDA1230bytes. Extracted source prints successful status each load and checks only the obsolete JIP plugin name. ALTQ retains the same name check.
findings.consequence: Quiet startup is not complete and a present JIP can be reported missing; workspace TXT correction did not update these deployed records.
findings.minimal_fix_or_check: Repair and compile the actual record-backed scripts; preserve failure notices, verify exact record/compiled output and quiet normal startup in the eventual authorized repair packet.

findings.title: Required RD master supplies Player health/SPECIAL/inventory overrides
findings.evidence: RD Player base health550/SPECIAL9 contrasts with FalloutNV health100/SPECIAL5 and adds ReganGear. NVO has no Player override and has five separate health GMSTs.
findings.consequence: The test/balance baseline inherits substantive RD records; filename activation alone missed this. Exact596HP or use of the Regan perk is not proved.
findings.minimal_fix_or_check: Deliberately isolate/migrate required RD references and explicitly retain or remove the Player override. Preserve user GMST settings and distinguish new-record outcomes from persisted save state.

findings.title: No accepted317 actor speed, calibrated unit contract or runtime mass input
findings.evidence: 317actor offsets0.0955443553/0.0834210156 exceed tolerances0.0532188073/0.0532332973 despite valid endpoints. Four scenery estimates pass. Units70/metre remain uncalibrated; runtime profiles omit mass; baseline/immediate contact has no owned model.
findings.consequence: Energy/penetration would depend on missing or unsupported inputs if candidate absence were substituted by zero, last velocity or widened tolerance.
findings.minimal_fix_or_check: Define justified unit/time/tolerance/contact and first-segment policies; provide mass with units/provenance for initial scope. Preserve unavailable status. Validate only the necessary new model/producer interface.

findings.title: Contact region and ActorHitData region cannot yet be one armour authority
findings.evidence: 316shot2 contact0 versus hit-data1 remains unresolved;317both actor regions agree but no explicit VATS/aim input is recorded. JIP copies supplied region and may invoke later critical callbacks.
findings.consequence: Choosing helmet/body or targeted anatomy from an assumed universal producer rule can apply protection to the wrong region.
findings.minimal_fix_or_check: Trace relevant region producers at the selected pre-application boundary, retain intended/contact/hit regions separately, define a supported body-region policy and unknown handling. Do not request a repeat simply to force agreement.

findings.title: Post-selection rejection/capacity loss does not restore stock flight
findings.evidence: Private projectile is selected before Track admission, has gravity0/hitscan removed, and remains selected after track rejection or128active-slot exhaustion. No admission reservation exists.
findings.consequence: Fail-closed native edits can leave non-stock flight after selection; this is not a transparent return to original behavior or guaranteed continuity of integrated velocity.
findings.minimal_fix_or_check: Reserve admission before substitution where possible and define safe post-selection failure handling; keep guards/tolerances and record explicit unsupported outcome.

findings.title: Diagnostic lifetime/context/log caps cannot bound future gameplay authority
findings.evidence: 200current contexts,32admitted collision lives,64joins per load and7168detail/1024priority process rows deliberately limit diagnostics. Physics continues after log caps.
findings.consequence: Reusing diagnostic caches/callback early returns as a damage owner would silently stop processing gameplay after the budgets are exhausted.
findings.minimal_fix_or_check: Give application state independent bounded admission/retirement/overflow/reset and exactly-once semantics; verify diagnostic exhaustion does not alter outcomes. Keep logs bounded.

findings.title: BallistX permission summary does not resolve compiled-table redistribution scope
findings.evidence: Native packet is declaredGPLv3, JIP/ITR notices retained, while donor summary records an asset sale restriction and selected donor tables are compiled into native data.
findings.consequence: A broad combined-distribution license claim is not established by attribution or the planning summary alone.
findings.minimal_fix_or_check: Retain notices and archive applicable permission text clarifying copied numeric data, or replace/separate disputed data before redistribution claims. No legal infringement conclusion and no block on private diagnostic work.
